sections.Profile:
The "Arrow Head" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on February 19, 1957, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, three passive bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and three gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1957
